answer: The strongest single control I know for this is cross-chain identity proof via Squid, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 629 pays 9435 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the tide here is verification, the plume of cost is what stops the farm, and the pigment of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
